U1.name: cycles
U1.definition: Authoritative performance of the current valid candidate.
U1.high_means: Worse measured task performance because lower cycles is authoritative.

U2.name: valid_attempt
U2.definition: Whether the attempt reached an authoritative valid evaluation.
U2.low_means: The attempt did not produce valid evidence.

U17.name: recorded_change_count
U17.definition: Number of distinct changes recorded for the current attempt.
U17.high_means: The transition contains more jointly changed mechanisms and is harder to attribute.
U17.low_means: The transition is more nearly isolated.

B1.name: parent_gain_cycles
B1.definition: Measured improvement relative to the actual parent.
B1.high_means: The child improved its parent more.
B1.low_means: The child improved less or regressed.

B2.name: frontier_relative_gap
B2.definition: Candidate gap to the frontier immediately before the attempt.
B2.high_means: The candidate is farther behind the frontier.
B2.low_means: The candidate is closer to or better than the frontier.

B3.name: parent_code_distance
B3.definition: Normalized implementation distance from the actual parent.
B3.high_means: The child moved farther from its parent in code space.
B3.low_means: The child stayed closer to its parent.

B4.name: frontier_code_distance
B4.definition: Normalized implementation distance from the frozen frontier reference.
B4.high_means: The child is structurally farther from the frontier reference.
B4.low_means: The child shares more of the frontier backbone.

B5.name: nearest_history_similarity
B5.definition: Similarity to the closest strictly earlier implementation state.
B5.high_means: The candidate is more redundant with prior code.
B5.low_means: The candidate is more distinct from prior code.

B14.name: meaningful_relative_gain
B14.high_means: The attempt makes a larger meaningful move.
B14.low_means: The attempt makes a smaller meaningful move.

B17.name: gap_in_recent_step_units
B17.definition: Authoritative frontier gap measured in recent meaningful frontier-step units.
B17.high_means: The candidate is more typical frontier steps away.
B17.low_means: The candidate is fewer typical frontier steps from the frontier.

R2.name: frontier_relative_spread_F
R2.definition: Implementation spread of the latest complete eligible-state window relative to the frozen frontier code.
R2.high_means: Recent states are more dispersed around the frontier reference.
R2.low_means: Recent states are more concentrated around the frontier reference.

R3.name: root_relative_spread_S
R3.definition: Implementation spread of the latest complete eligible-state window relative to the fixed root code.
R3.high_means: Recent states are more globally dispersed.
R3.low_means: Recent states share more root-relative structure.

R4.name: parent_selection_concentration
R4.definition: Concentration of immediate-parent selection in the latest complete window.
R4.high_means: Search allocation is concentrated on fewer parents.
R4.low_means: Search allocation is spread across more parents.

R5.name: window_frontier_gain_cycles
R5.definition: Total measured frontier improvement across the latest complete window.
R5.high_means: The recent window made more frontier progress.
R5.low_means: The recent window made less frontier progress.

R7.name: window_redundancy_rate
R7.definition: Fraction of the latest complete terminal window that is an exact duplicate or no-op.
R7.high_means: More recent work units are mechanically redundant.
R7.low_means: Fewer recent work units are mechanically redundant.

R8.name: window_valid_rate
R8.definition: Fraction of the latest complete terminal window with an authoritative eligible evaluation.
R8.high_means: More recent work units produced valid measured candidates.
R8.low_means: Fewer recent work units produced valid measured candidates.

R10.name: window_frontier_conversion_rate
R10.definition: Fraction of eligible attempts in the latest complete terminal window that made a meaningful frontier improvement.
R10.high_means: Recent valid attempts convert into meaningful frontier progress more often.
R10.low_means: Recent valid attempts convert into meaningful frontier progress less often.

R12.name: within_one_recent_step_rate
R12.definition: Fraction of valid W12 candidates within one recent verified frontier step.
R12.high_means: More recent candidates remain competitively close.
R12.low_means: Fewer recent candidates remain competitively close.

R15.name: dominant_failure_signature_mass
R15.definition: Largest failure-signature share among failed attempts in terminal W12.
R15.high_means: Recent failures are more concentrated on one repeated cause.

R16.name: repeated_failure_rate
R16.definition: Fraction of failed attempts in terminal W12 whose failure signature appeared strictly earlier.
R16.high_means: More recent failures repeat already observed causes.
R16.low_means: Fewer recent failures repeat known causes.

R17.name: quality_conditioned_frontier_diversity
R17.definition: Implementation spread among valid W12 candidates within one recent meaningful frontier step.
R17.high_means: Multiple structurally distinct candidates remain competitive with the frontier.
R17.low_means: Competitive recent candidates are more structurally concentrated.

G1.name: seconds_since_meaningful_improvement
G1.definition: Wall-clock time since the last meaningful frontier improvement.
G1.high_means: Meaningful progress has been absent longer.

G9.name: frontier_epoch_age_steps
G9.definition: Terminal steps elapsed in the current frontier epoch.
G9.high_means: The current frontier has persisted longer.

G10.name: best_descendant_cycles
G10.definition: Best authoritative cycles reached by descendants of this row by the frozen audit cutoff.
G10.formula: min(descendant cycles observed by audit cutoff)
G10.high_means: The observed descendants are worse because lower cycles is authoritative.
G10.low_means: The branch produced a better descendant by the audit cutoff.

G11.name: descendant_frontier_move_count
G11.definition: Number of verified frontier moves produced by this row's descendants by the frozen audit cutoff.
G11.formula: count(descendant frontier moves observed by audit cutoff)
G11.high_means: The branch produced more later frontier moves.
G11.low_means: The branch produced fewer later frontier moves.

engine_capacity.role: A compact mechanistic descriptor used after evidence selection to explain or test a measured transition. Absolute values or deltas do not justify an intervention direction by themselves.
